verdict.rationale: Retention policy is a fair question for an enterprise meeting-transcription SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no scheduled auto-deletion, no retention policy settings, and no admin-initiated permanent erasure. Adjacent admin controls (audit trails, activity logs, SSO, opting out of AI training) do not cover retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand
